note: T2 capture, two runs on the OnePlus 6T. Geometry in dp (1 dp = 2.625 px) and the apps' own labels only. Run 1 2026-10-10 01:27-02:06: stopped early at Mnemo after a scripted multi-tap hit a reminder's inline Snooze (see _screens-sources/t2/notes.md). Run 2 2026-10-10 13:26-15:16 (daytime): one tap per command with a fresh screenshot before each, only own 'Sample alarm N' items touched, one test alarm at a time, each deleted after; lock screen not tested (phone kept unlocked). Run 2 covered the reminders of simplereminder, rereminder and medtimer, and org.fossify.clock's alarm. It stopped at 15:10 when another adb session took the phone's foreground. Not reached: cyclicalarms, Mnemo ringing, chronicle and equipoise item and calendar pages.

Delete or reschedule: long-press a row to get an action mode with Reschedule and Delete. Delete is immediate, with no confirm and no undo.
